snippet.title: Dr Harrison: Level 1 👨‍🔧
snippet.description:
Dr Harrison is a strategy arcade game made by XLM Software in 1995. Dr Harrison has to get out of the research center invade by robots, to do so he has to collect keys, bombs (to eliminate robots), hearts and gems (to earn points). There are three types of robots: purple, yellow and green. The purple robots are very stupid simpleton who wander around, the yellow ones are patrollers while the green robots are stalkers who see through walls and chase the protagonist to kill him mercilessly (present from level 2).

n.b: Dr Harrison is a shareware game so you can only play two levels of the "reboot" which differ from the levels seen in the video because they are from the first version of the game.

Download the last version of Dr Harrison in German here (0,6 MB): https://www.xlmsoft.de/spiele.php
Supported OS: Windows 95/98/Me/2000/XP/Vista/7/8/10*. 

Try it online in English: https://archive.org/details/XLMsDr.Harrison_1020

*It is only supported by the 32-bit versions of the listed operating systems. Consequently, as Windows 11 is only 64-bit it cannot be opened. If you don't want to play online, I suggest you create a VM with Virtualbox and install Windows 2000, downloadable for free from the winworldpc site.

Dance, Don't Delay by Twin Musicom is a song authorized by Creative Commons Attribution (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
Source: http://www.twinmusicom.org/song/303/dance-dont-delay
Artist: http://www.twinmusicom.org
